test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

There are a lot of things that _________ to a healthy lifestyle.
solution: The correct answer is **'contribute'** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is in Simple Present Tense. • So, "contributing" and "contributed" can not be the answer as they are Continuous and participle form respectively. • As the subject is plural, so the blank needs a plural verb here. • So, the appropriate word for the given blank is **'contribute'.** **The correct sentence will be: ***There are a lot of things that** contribute** to a healthy life.__* *__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__*** __ • दिया गया वाक्य **Simple Present Tense** में है। • इसलिए, "**contributing**" और "**contributed**" उत्तर नहीं हो सकते हैं क्योंकि वे क्रमशः Continuous और participle form हैं। • जैसा कि subject बहुवचन है, इसलिए रिक्त स्थान को यहाँ बहुवचन क्रिया की आवश्यकता है। • अत: दिए गए रिक्त स्थान के लिए उपयुक्त शब्द 'contribute' है। **इसलिए सही वाक्य होगा:** *There are a lot of things that contribute to a healthy life.__* 4e:T975, The correct answer is **'Bad things may happen before the task is finished'**
